svg.title: Echoes ACT 1 → Echoes ACT 2 → Echoes ACT 3
svg.desc: Sticks sound effects onto anything, and the words keep echoing. The sounds come alive: touch the word BOING and you bounce. 3 FREEZE! Pins its target to the ground under its own weight.
